title: Long spin before the Barcelona flight (+Sun spin)
coachNotes:
EXECUTION: 75min spin at 120-135bpm, cadence 85-95rpm. Done by 12:30, before leaving for MXP (16:45).
GYM: none.
FUEL: 500ml Tailwind on the bike. 1L water before the flight, 500ml on board.
GARMIN: ~70-90.
STOP RULE: HRV under 50 or RHR 53+ on waking = 40min only, the extra 30 is dropped, not moved.
WHY: carries Sunday's skipped 30 load at zero impact; Tue quality (90) stays untouched.
